reception: In the wider literature the paper functions mostly as an early exhibit of machine learning applied inside a compiler: the bulk of its citations are brief mentions in surveys and related-work discussions of learned compilation, citing it as an early demonstration rather than engaging its classifiers. A smaller group adopts the method as a template, training supervised models to predict other decisions — heterogeneous task partitioning, thread-coarsening on graphics processors, transactional-memory tuning, loop iteration counts, and unroll factors in high-level synthesis — while work on automatic feature generation and on selecting optimizations from performance counters measures itself against it. Direct extensions are rare; the paper's reach is as a precedent and a recipe.
